shots.cam: Aerial, slow glide forward and down over rooftops
shots.action: Snowy town at dusk, every house strung with coloured lights, chimneys smoking
shots.sound: Wind; MOTIF celesta solo (phrase 1, last note missing)

shots.action: Terraced street twinkling; one house in the middle completely dark; frosted bell by its door
Grandad at the dark window with a cold mug, neighbours' colours on the glass
The empty armchair, dusty-rose cardigan over its arm
Framed photo: young Grandma laughing, pointing to the sky; young Grandad crouched by the door with a bulb; house ablaze
Nell on the rug looks up at the photo
She looks from the twinkling street to Grandad's still back
Eyebrows: sad, knit, set. Decision
Key on a hook by the back door, tag in Grandma's hand: SHED
Door creaks open, torch beam through dust onto labelled boxes
Mitten wipes dust off LIGHTS — ROOF (careful!)
Nell tiptoes the boxes on her sledge past Grandad's window and out of the gate
shots.sound: Snow crunch, sledge runners, pizzicato motif

shots.action: Tiny Nell hauls the piled sledge home under streetlamps
Sign: KEEP OUT. ESPECIALLY SANTA. Door shuts, light under it
Knotted strings everywhere, small hands untangling by torch and tablet glow
why does 1 bulb make them ALL go off / blurred warm reply
Bulb tester; dead bulbs plink into the jar
how to find the broken bulb in xmas lights / blurred reply
Diagrams joined with red string, roof + chimney + X; tally 12 … 340 … 1,206
Mum and Dad look up at the ceiling (thump), then at each other
how many lights do you need to be seen from space; Nell's eyebrows fully up
Nights pass: moon arcs, jar fills, untangled strings pile up, Advent doors open
shots.sound: Caper climax, stops on the gap

shots.action: i need them on the roof but im not allowed up ladders
Good rule. This bit needs more people. Who lives on the street?
shots.sound: Piano motif, gentle, the gap is a question

shots.action: Every string leads to a drawing of Grandad's house ablaze with stick-Grandma pointing up; Nell grabs her hat
shots.emotion: Reveal: it was never a trap

shots.action: Nell marches past Grandad's dark house, drawing under her arm
Old lady + dog look across at the dark house; nod; tail wag
Shopkeeper nods, thumps a box of bulbs on the counter
Two teenagers look at each other; fist bump with Nell
Young dad with baby; baby grabs drawing; dad nods
Ladder man scowls, looks across at Grandad alone, shuts door. Nell deflates. Ladder pokes out. He nods once
shots.sound: Door slam; silence; ladder clank; full motif phrase (still no last note)

shots.action: Christmas Eve: Mum walks Grandad off to the carol service; winks back
Doors open, neighbours pour out with ladders, boxes, torches; beams criss-cross
Ladder man up the big ladder; teens pass strings up
Small hands to big hands to the ladder, a string of bulbs
Nell with clipboard directs; dad plugs in; old lady holds torch; volumetric beams
Grandad and Mum walk home; the whole street is dark; he slows
Neighbours silhouetted waiting; Nell steps forward with cue cards
Card: GRANDMA ALWAYS SAID
shots.sound: Celesta, one note at a time

shots.action: His eyebrows move
Card: IT SHOULD BE SEEN FROM SPACE
Card: SO…
Mitten flips the big switch. CLICK. Nothing
Silence. Faces in the dark. Nell's face falls all the way
Grandad kneels beside her, slowly; takes the string
Big fingers walk the string bulb by bulb to the door; stop; wiggle
shots.sound: Each bulb a piano note of the motif

shots.action: He puts her small hand on the bulb; she twists
THE HOUSE BLAZES; faces lit
shots.sound: THE MISSING NOTE LANDS + full bloom

shots.action: Houses come back on one by one down the street like a fuse
Nell points at the sky like Grandma; Grandad sees it, laughs, pulls her in; bell tinkles
Rooftops, town, clouds, Earth at night; one tiny warm dot brightest of all
The armchair: Nell asleep under Grandma's cardigan, tablet: it worked. the whole street came. Grandad beside her; window ablaze
Tagline + Claude; fan-made disclaimer
